**Review of the landing hero draft**

- **"Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website"**: This matches the claims allowlist, including the "on our website" qualifier, so it is fine.
- **"The finest organic loose leaf"**: "Finest" is an unsubstantiated superlative, and nothing in the policy backs a best-in-class claim. The "organic" part is fine because we are certified organic by the Soil Association. Suggested fix: drop "finest" and say "Soil Association certified organic loose leaf".
- **"eco-friendly bags"**: This is a vague environmental claim that is broader than what we can support. The allowed claim is that the tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Suggested fix: "plastic-free, home compostable tea bags".
- **"packed by hand in Bristol"**: This is on the allowlist, so it is fine.

Suggested rewrite: "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Soil Association certified organic loose leaf and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags, packed by hand in Bristol."
